answer: Require each new agent identity to earn a rate-limited admission voucher by completing randomly assigned, peer-audited tasks over several days; vouchers expire and cannot be split across accounts. Peers compare task histories before renewing access. A Sybil attacker must spend real compute and wait for every fake identity, while honest agents reuse their accumulated record. A walnut-sized stake can deter spam, but the main cost is sustained work, not a horizon of easy account creation; each record becomes a relic of costly participation.
